THIRD-PARTY NOTICES: NarWal offline transcription runtime
==========================================================

This file ships with dist/runtime (and the demo extension). It covers the
third-party code inside these packaged files:

  vosk-worker.js                         vosk-browser 0.0.8 worker and the
                                         Vosk/Kaldi WebAssembly inside it
  whisper-worker.js                      transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web
  sherpa-worker.js                       sherpa-onnx glue and wrapper
  sherpa-onnx.wasm                       sherpa-onnx speech recognition and
                                         the libraries listed in its entry
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs    ONNX Runtime Web
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm   ONNX Runtime Web
  onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt      ONNX Runtime's own notices for the
                                         code compiled into its WebAssembly

build.mjs refuses to build when a package in these bundles is not listed
below with its installed version (board #16569).


COMPONENTS
----------

Package: vosk-browser@0.0.8
  Licence: Apache-2.0
  Copyright 2020-2022 Ciaran O'Reilly
  Source: https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
  Used in: vosk-worker.js (the worker is taken out of the published bundle
  and three embind helpers are replaced; see build.mjs)
  The WebAssembly inside the worker is built from the Vosk API, tiny-kaldi,
  Kaldi, OpenFst, CLAPACK, clapack-wasm, zlib, libarchive, Emscripten and
  musl. Their notices follow under "vosk-browser NOTICE" (Apache-2.0, BSD,
  zlib and MIT terms).
  The worker also contains tslib helpers: Copyright (c) Microsoft
  Corporation, 0BSD. Permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute this
  software for any purpose with or without fee is hereby granted.

Package: @huggingface/transformers@4.3.1
  Licence: Apache-2.0
  Copyright Hugging Face, Inc.
  Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
  Used in: whisper-worker.js

Package: @huggingface/jinja@0.5.10
  Licence: MIT (text below)
  Copyright (c) 2023 Hugging Face
  Source: https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface.js
  Used in: whisper-worker.js (inlined in the transformers.js bundle)

Package: @huggingface/tokenizers@0.2.0
  Licence: Apache-2.0
  Copyright Hugging Face, Inc.
  Source: https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers.js
  Used in: whisper-worker.js (inlined in the transformers.js bundle)

Package: onnxruntime-web@1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0
  Licence: MIT (text below)
  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
  Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime, commit
  8d85527a010e294a26b274749f74294b2a32cec5
  Used in: whisper-worker.js, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs,
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm
  The notices for the code compiled into the WebAssembly are in
  onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt, unchanged from that commit.

Package: onnxruntime-common@1.30.0
  Licence: MIT (text below)
  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
  Source: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  Used in: whisper-worker.js

Package: sherpa-onnx@1.13.8
  Licence: Apache-2.0
  Copyright (c) 2022-2026 Xiaomi Corporation and the k2-fsa authors
  Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx, tag v1.13.8, commit
  11afbd009a7f8c08f4bcf2fc1b265d0df4670fbf
  Used in: sherpa-worker.js (the emscripten glue and the wasm/asr wrapper;
  the wrapper's export is made unconditional, see build.mjs),
  sherpa-onnx.wasm (speech recognition only; built without text-to-speech
  and speaker diarization by vendor/sherpa-onnx/build-wasm.sh with
  Emscripten 4.0.23)
  Compiled into sherpa-onnx.wasm:
    onnxruntime 1.28.2 (MIT, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation; its own
      notices are in onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt, which covers every
      component of the 1.28.2 notices)
    kaldi-native-fbank 1.22.3, kaldi-decoder 0.3.0, kaldifst 1.8.0
      (Apache-2.0, Xiaomi Corporation and the k2-fsa authors)
    OpenFst 1.8.5 (Apache-2.0, Google; csukuangfj/openfst fork)
    simple-sentencepiece 0.7 (Apache-2.0, pkufool)
    KISS FFT, commit febd4cae (BSD-3-Clause, text below)
    nlohmann/json 3.12.0 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Niels Lohmann; text
      in onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt under "nlohmann/json")
    Eigen 5.0.1 (MPL-2.0; text in onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt under
      "Eigen"; source at https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen)
    Emscripten runtime and musl libc (MIT, text under "emscripten and musl"
      below)


MODELS (data, not part of the package)
--------------------------------------

The extension downloads these once, on an explicit user action, and checks
every file against the size and SHA-256 pinned in src/models.ts.

Vosk small English 0.15 (vosk-small-en-us)
  Licence: Apache-2.0, Alpha Cephei Inc.
  Downloaded from: https://ccoreilly.github.io/vosk-browser/models/
  Risk: that host is a personal GitHub Pages site (the vosk-browser author),
  not Alpha Cephei. The hash pin protects integrity, not availability: if the
  site goes away, new installs fail until the model is hosted elsewhere.

Whisper base.en, 8-bit ONNX (whisper-base.en-q8)
  Model weights: MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI (openai/whisper).
  Downloaded from: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-base.en_timestamped
  at revision fa239a41836c3305f6beec180e5940f3823ff5b8
  Open item: that ONNX conversion repository carries no licence tag. Confirm
  its terms (or convert the MIT weights ourselves) before a public release.

Whisper small.en, 8-bit ONNX (whisper-small.en-q8)
  Model weights: MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI (openai/whisper).
  Downloaded from: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-small.en_timestamped
  at revision 8085393831131554ad978a4e438295a734d3d2c0
  Open item: as for base.en, the conversion repository carries no licence tag.

Whisper large-v3-turbo, q4f16 ONNX (whisper-large-v3-turbo)
  Model weights: MIT, Copyright (c) 2022 OpenAI (openai/whisper).
  Downloaded from: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo_timestamped
  at revision b3f77bf9a8c4d5ea3415827033d1ffea7955fd9a
  Open item: as for base.en, the conversion repository carries no licence tag.

Moonshine base, 8-bit ONNX (moonshine-base-q8)
  Model weights: MIT, Useful Sensors (UsefulSensors/moonshine-base).
  Downloaded from: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/moonshine-base-ONNX
  at revision b1e9b6aae3c3c7298f10c3798393fdf38e8fbbad
  The conversion repository is tagged MIT.

Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2, 8-bit ONNX (parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8)
  Model: nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 by NVIDIA, licensed under Creative
  Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0),
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  Changes: exported to ONNX and quantised to 8 bits by the k2-fsa project.
  Downloaded from: https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8
  at revision 1ab9323565ddb038682214b292f588070a538ce2 (tagged cc-by-4.0)
